authorization_scope: Implement and measure preregistered controls only; candidate production access, solver calls, and scientific promotion remain forbidden.

basis.recommended_policy: control-first; no candidate access until positive, negative, replay, and statistical control gates pass

control_scope.trajectory_count_formula: 2 controls * (4 training sizes * 5 training seeds + 2 holdout sizes * 3 holdout seeds) * 4096

required_preconditions: sampler implementation and independent replay pass bounded exact n<=5 equivalence
large-N path contains no unlabeled-level enumeration, factorial canonicalization, or approximate fallback
Minkowski four-dimensional control implementation passes independent replay and ordering-fraction anchor audit
hard wall-time, process-tree, resident-memory, disk, checkpoint, and atomic-promotion controls are active
all control seeds and sizes are disjointly recorded as training or holdout
spectral-window and statistical thresholds are learned from control training data only and validated without holdout refit
allowed_operations: implement exact naturally birth-labeled candidate and random-control sampler paths
implement fixed-cardinality four-dimensional Minkowski sprinkling control
execute random-growth and geometric controls at the preregistered finite sizes
compute per-seed observables, control-training thresholds, and simultaneous intervals
validate control holdout data without refitting
write checkpointed temporary artifacts and atomically promote only validated results
record RESOURCE_LIMIT_OPEN when any hard limit or exactness condition fails
forbidden_operations: sample or inspect candidate production trajectories before control promotion
use target_dimension, fixed metric, or external physical time in the candidate path
tune candidate fugacities or thresholds using candidate or holdout data
retry a failed seed with a replacement seed
use an approximate sampler or silently relax an exact down-set cap
issue a continuum, dimension, Spin-2, universal-coupling, or complete-lattice verdict
